_note: S9 v1 PROVISIONAL poses. The MC2 game camera is map-centered at world origin; setPosition clamps to the map interior. pos = [x,y,z] world units (z is overridden to terrain elevation by setPosition's land-follow). rot = cameraRotation degrees, proj = projectionAngle degrees, alt = camera altitude. These framings were picked for stability (map-interior, looking across terrain) but should be re-authored from a [BOOKMARK v1] in-game dump once the authoring hotkey lands (owner doc 2.1b). Animation clock is UNPINNED in v1 (water/FX phase): these framings minimize water in view; residual scroll phase is a known v2 mask item.
